from PIL import Image, ImageStat
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/Users/a123/.openclaw/workspace/images/xbxlr_honey_sweet_potato_cheese_four_panel_black_ip.png')
im=Image.open(p).convert('RGB')
# Analyze quadrant dark pixels and orange/yellow pixels as crude QA
w,h=im.size
for name,box in [('TL',(0,0,w//2,h//2)),('TR',(w//2,0,w,h//2)),('BL',(0,h//2,w//2,h)),('BR',(w//2,h//2,w,h))]:
 crop=im.crop(box)
 pix=list(crop.getdata())
 dark=sum(1 for r,g,b in pix if r<60 and g<60 and b<60)
 white=sum(1 for r,g,b in pix if r>230 and g>230 and b>230)
 orange=sum(1 for r,g,b in pix if r>180 and 80<g<180 and b<80)
 print(name, 'dark%', round(dark/len(pix)*100,2), 'white%', round(white/len(pix)*100,2), 'orange%', round(orange/len(pix)*100,2))
PY
